title: Docker -cgo image does not work
body:
**Describe the bug**

Building inside goreleaser/goreleaser:v0.134-cgo image fails

**To Reproduce**

```
docker run --rm -w /app -v $(pwd):/app goreleaser/goreleaser:v0.134-cgo --snapshot --rm-dist
```

Error:

```
   ⨯ release failed after 65.17s error=failed to build for linux_386: # runtime/cgo
/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-alpine-linux-musl/9.2.0/../../../../x86_64-alpine-linux-musl/bin/ld: skipping incompatible /usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-alpine-linux-musl/9.2.0/../../../libssp_nonshared.a when searching for -lssp_nonshared
/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-alpine-linux-musl/9.2.0/../../../../x86_64-alpine-linux-musl/bin/ld: skipping incompatible /usr/lib/libssp_nonshared.a when searching for -lssp_nonshared
/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-alpine-linux-musl/9.2.0/../../../../x86_64-alpine-linux-musl/bin/ld: cannot find -lssp_nonshared
/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-alpine-linux-musl/9.2.0/../../../../x86_64-alpine-linux-musl/bin/ld: skipping incompatible /usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-alpine-linux-musl/9.2.0/libgcc.a when searching for -lgcc
/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-alpine-linux-musl/9.2.0/../../../../x86_64-alpine-linux-musl/bin/ld: cannot find -lgcc
/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-alpine-linux-musl/9.2.0/../../../../x86_64-alpine-linux-musl/bin/ld: skipping incompatible /usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-alpine-linux-musl/9.2.0/../../../libgcc_s.so.1 when searching for libgcc_s.so.1
/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-alpine-linux-musl/9.2.0/../../../../x86_64-alpine-linux-musl/bin/ld: skipping incompatible /usr/lib/libgcc_s.so.1 when searching for libgcc_s.so.1
/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-alpine-linux-musl/9.2.0/../../../../x86_64-alpine-linux-musl/bin/ld: cannot find libgcc_s.so.1
/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-alpine-linux-musl/9.2.0/../../../../x86_64-alpine-linux-musl/bin/ld: skipping incompatible /usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-alpine-linux-musl/9.2.0/libgcc.a when searching for -lgcc
/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-alpine-linux-musl/9.2.0/../../../../x86_64-alpine-linux-musl/bin/ld: cannot find -lgcc
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```

```yaml
project_name: project
before:
  hooks:
    - go mod tidy
builds:
-
  id: "project-build"
  env:
  - CGO_ENABLED=1
  binary: project
  goos:
  - linux
....
```

> Make sure your config file is valid by running
> `goreleaser check -f path-to-config-file`.

**Expected behavior**

Build and exit

**Environment (please complete the following information):**

- OS: linuxu
- OS version: ```Linux kochan-pc 5.3.0-51-generic #44-Ubuntu SMP Wed Apr 22 21:09:44 UTC 2020 x86_64 x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linux```

- GoReleaser Version goreleaser/goreleaser:v0.134-cgo

**Additional context**
Add any other context about the problem here. Full output log with debug on
is probably a helpful thing to add here.
